_comment: phpgraph (https://github.com/hbenabdallah/phpgraph) as the run's MCP server:
make bench ARGS="--mcp=phpgraph …". The published PHAR is downloaded once,
checked against its .sha256, and kept in var/bench/tools. The graph is written
next to the run, not in the project, so 'changes nothing' still holds.
{repo}, {project} and {run} are replaced for each run; 'grants' are the tools
allowed without a confirmation, as the bench grants file_write and shell_exec.
